method_correction.note: the first attempt had two implementation errors: (1) it reused one scratch case, so on restart the morpher read the previously moved 0/polyMesh and the realized control points in 0/uniform and compounded one mode on the previous one; (2) the sine-mode generator omitted the candidate frequency factors, so every candidate of one axis was the same (1,1,1) field. Both make the recorded Pass A efficiency and normalization invalid. The fixes delete 0/polyMesh, 0/uniform and 0/parametricCoordinatesbox before every morpher run and apply the full sin(a*pi*i/7) sin(b*pi*j/7) sin(c*pi*k/7) field. No flow response is involved.
